rationale: The plan uses PyDESeq2 Wald with median-of-ratios size factors, an explicit condition design with control as reference and coefficient verification, apeglm shrinkage, and BH at a stated alpha, all in Python, which fits the unpaired 6v6 single-batch design; the shallow sample is quantified, kept, and handled by a stated leave-one-out sensitivity rule rather than silent exclusion. QC has library sizes and a condition-colored PCA with sample_01 annotated but omits a sample distance heatmap. No low-count filter before the fit is stated anywhere, only a remark that the matrix is probably pre-filtered. Enrichment uses gseapy prerank on the full ranked list with the metric stated and an explicit ORA universe, but the Hallmark collection version, the 15-500 set-size window, and a fixed seed are not specified.
